messages:
sam (frontend): quick idea for today's nav sync: treat breadcrumbs as first-class state carriers. instead of only being navigational, clicking a crumb could restore sibling filters for that level. saves a step for users who drill down then want to step back with context.

marta (ux): interested, but need to be careful. users might expect crumb = clean view. propose a subtle affordance: breadcrumbs show a small dot if clicking will preserve filters. tooltip: "Restore view (preserves filters)".

jordan (design): visual language should avoid clutter. dot can be low-contrast and only visible on hover/focus. also consider an option in the breadcrumb menu: "Restore with filters" vs "Go to clean".

eli (eng): implementation-wise: crumb clicks could include params: `/models?crumb_level=2&restore=1&f=...` or we can use `restore=true` and rehydrate. we need a deterministic contract for which filters are sibling-level vs global.

zara (product): telemetry ask: add `nav_action=breadcrumb_restore` so we can measure adoption. also track when users choose clean vs restore to guide defaults.

a11y-bot: accessibility: ensure crumb affordance is reachable by keyboard and exposes `aria-haspopup` if there's a menu. when a restore happens, announce via aria-live: "Restored: 3 filters applied". avoid surprise focus jumps.

sam (frontend): for defaults: make crumb click perform clean navigate, hold-modifier (e.g., Alt/Cmd) for restore. that reduces accidental restores. we'll still provide explicit menu option for power users.

marta (ux): modifier-only is clever but not discoverable. combine: default clean click, menu item "Restore with filters", and a toast hint the first time: "Tip: use breadcrumb menu to restore previous filters".

jordan (design): small copy nits: use "Restore view" and "Open clean view" for clarity. update tooltip for permalink actions to "Share exact view".

eli (eng): ok action items: sam to prototype crumb affordance and history behavior; marta to mock tooltip/menu states; zara to add telemetry keys; a11y-bot to propose aria strings. follow-up in next design stand. :+1:
